subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should `announce:` become a backend-only agent idempotency/run-id namespace, or should announce recovery use a non-prefix authenticated marker before this PR merges?
rationale: The remaining blocker is repairable, but the durable marker defines a public run-id namespace and internal recovery boundary that should be intentional.

options.title: Reserve `announce:` for backend handoffs
options.body: Reject or bypass non-backend agent requests using `announce:` idempotency keys and keep the current marker model for authenticated announce delivery.

options.title: Use authenticated metadata instead
options.body: Derive `announceLastRun` only from trusted announce handoff metadata so public idempotency strings remain opaque.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a unified durable model for all inter-session delivery recovery rather than an announce-specific namespace.

recommendation.title: Reserve `announce:` for backend handoffs
recommendation.body: Reject or bypass non-backend agent requests using `announce:` idempotency keys and keep the current marker model for authenticated announce delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent restart recovery lifecycle and Codex internal-turn tool policy work make this the closest available owner for the boundary choice.
